test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following gases is NOT included in greenhouse gases?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitrogen.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The major greenhouse gases are:

 
 
• Water Vapour - causes about 36% - 70% of the greenhouse effect
 
• Carbon dioxide (CO2) which causes 9 - 26%
 
• Methane (CH4) causes 4 - 9%
 
• Ozone (O3)
 
• Nitrous Oxide
 
• Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)
 
 
 
• **Hence, Nitrogen is the correct answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Greenhouse effect

 
 
• It occurs due to the increase in the percentage of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
 
• It absorbs the solar rays and energy of the sun due to which the temperature on the earth increases and nature's balance gets disturbed.
 
• Our vehicles and industries are continuously increasing the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
